items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All ACs implemented: probe + route + combobox + status caption + unchanged server validation + unchanged Implementation-model wiring; no extra features beyond scope.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Probe never throws; route always returns HTTP 200 across ok/stale/unavailable; no unhandled null at any boundary.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: execFile(shell:false) with fixed literal args, no injection surface; catalog slugs re-filtered through CODEX_MODEL_SLUG_PATTERN before reaching the client; display_name renders through React; launch validation untouched.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Every new test asserts observable outcomes, not internals; happy + error/degrade paths covered per behavior.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: TTL + failure-TTL caching bounds probe frequency; async execFile never blocks the event loop; catalog is a handful of entries.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Files match existing conventions; all new/modified files 279 lines or fewer.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer (codex debug models stdout) -> consumer (codex-models-probe.ts) identified; real captured-JSON fixture round-trips through the probe's unit tests (touches_io_boundary Boundary Probe sub-step satisfied).
